limitations: AI transcribed the original images and independent checking expressions; this is not instructor certification.

Each modal residual and boundary trace is checked symbolically. Polynomial sine coefficient identities are checked for every positive n; other coefficients have the exact finite-index integral checks listed.

Checks do not establish arbitrary termwise differentiation or pointwise regularity of infinite series. Corner incompatibilities and generalized solution interpretations are stated in the explanations.
The script does not parse all HTML math. Content hashes bind the reviewed explanations.
